# GreenExE 4.0

GreenExE 4.0 is a student technology and innovation competition by the Association of Software Engineering (ASE) at NSBM Green University, Sri Lanka. Teams design technology solutions for a Smart Green City: connected, efficient, intelligent and sustainable environments.

## Official information

- Competition and registration: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/competition
- Registration: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/register
- Rules and eligibility: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/rules
- Smart Green City concept: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/smart-city
- Frequently asked questions: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/faq
- Organizer: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/organizer
- Contact: https://greenexe-4.asensbm.live/contact

## Competition scope

Teams of 2–5 students may propose Smart Green City solutions in smart energy, mobility, water and waste management, buildings and infrastructure, environmental monitoring, connected digital services, or other sustainable innovation.

For final dates, eligibility details, requirements, and registration availability, use the official competition, rules, and registration pages above.
